text: Deferred Service Revenue On December 5, DataForce signed a four-month contract to perform work for $750 per month, with the entire contract price of $3,000 received in advance. At that time, DataForce increased cash and recorded a liability of $3,000 in Unearned Revenue, as illustrated in Chapter 2. On December 31, the following adjustment transfers $750, the revenue earned in December, to Fee Revenue and reduces the liability Unearned Revenue by the same amount: Transaction: Adjustment to recognize portion of revenue earned in December.
